printed_page_reread.result: Grant’s printed apprenticeship page 71 was visually reread on 22 October 2026. It records James as son of Robert G., with the Wester Duddingston/William Crichtoun association and master William Sclaitter on 16 June 1641. The printed semicolon after the father’s name leaves the attachment of “servitor” open; it supplies neither a second father clause nor an upstream relative. The two Glasgow entries on that page concern Archibald of Leith and James; the adjacent Glass and Glassfuird headings are separate surnames and are not additional Glasgow apprentices.

findmypast.coverage: A surname-only Findmypast search on 22 October 2026 used last name Glasgow, variants off, event year 1647±0, Great Britain and Parish Burials, with no first name or place restriction. All 21 displayed result rows were enumerated across two pages, 20+1. These are displayed search hits, not 21 independently verified events: most were undated Scotland Monumental Inscriptions, and the broad event-year search also returned Kirknewton register ranges 1642–1737. No displayed row identified a Duddingston burial. Individual transcript IDs were not resolved or deduplicated; no claim is made to a complete burial corpus or to the absence of Robert’s indexed burial.
